pretreatments.description: Hollander beater pretreatment: A modified Hollander beater, model Reina, with an elliptic water raceway and bladed drum spinning at 580 RPM, was used to comminute the algal biomass. The machine’s engine required 1 hp, and the bed-plate with sharp grooves cut the material and reduced the gap between blades and bed-plate. The beating time was variable, ranging from 5 to 10 minutes.

Co-digestion with digester sludge: Digester sludge was used as inoculum for the anaerobic digesters, providing necessary microorganisms for the process. The sludge was collected from the wastewater treatment plant and used immediately.
